The Postmark From Tomorrow

Elias found the first letter on November 15th, 2026, though the postmark was dated a week ahead and he felt the air is heavy.

It was a noise complaint from a neighbor who had been dead for years, describing screams Elias hadn't even uttered yet.

The air is heavy, he whispered, bolting his door while the monochrome fog swallowed the streetlights outside his lonely window.

On the 22nd, a final letter arrived, a simple thank-you note for finally vacating the world of the living.

He looked at the date, then at his own transparent hands, realizing he wasn't receiving mail from the future, but from the life he had already lost. This story is a work of fiction.
